scenarios.title: Hook recreates `.git` after materialise unlinks it, before the check
scenarios.setup: background hook waits for `.flow-scratch-owned`, then creates `.git/` + HEAD
scenarios.expected: a `.git` present at check time is an undeclared entry and must be refused (the obligations must not discover a repository)
scenarios.observed: REFUSED/UNSUPPORTED_CHECKOUT: the checkout holds 1 file(s) the tree does not declare (for example [".git/HEAD"]): a hook or the host created them, so the obligations would not see exactly the verified tree; no receipt

post.reason: the checkout holds 1 file(s) the tree does not declare (for example [".git/HEAD"]): a hook or the host created them, so the obligations would not see exactly the verified tree
